role_checks.operator: Perform the displayed inspection only; do not adjust outside operator scope.
role_checks.senior-operator: Confirm the inspection result and preserve any justified override.
role_checks.millwright: Localize the mechanical relationship before adjustment.
role_checks.maintenance: Review the bounded procedure and intervention history.
role_checks.technician: Compare controller intent with the verified physical response.
role_checks.qa: Verify the defect against the active sampling plan.
role_checks.engineering: Review the envelope and evidence before changing the model.
role_checks.plant-manager: Assign the next qualified owner; do not diagnose the machine.
